translations.web: Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.
translations.bsb: Be merciful to me, O God, for men are hounding me; all day they press their attack.
translations.kjv: Be merciful unto me, O God: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresseth
translations.asv: Be merciful unto me, O God; for man would swallow me up: All the day long he fighting oppresseth me.
